Spain attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed tourism infrastructure.

col: southern Spain｜miền nam Tây Ban Nha
mainland Spain｜Tây Ban Nha đại lục
travel to Spain｜du lịch đến Tây Ban Nha
tip: Tên nước viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không dùng the.

senses.zh: chơi; tham gia trò chơi hoặc thể thao
senses.en: Enjoy an activity or take part in a game
Perform music or a role, or make a recording run
A story written for actors to perform

ex.en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.

col: play a role in｜đóng vai trò trong
put on a play｜diễn một vở kịch
tip: Trước môn bóng thường không có mạo từ; trước nhạc cụ thường dùng the.

senses.en: not the same as someone or something else
used to describe several separate people, things, or types

ex.en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.

col: different perspectives｜những góc nhìn khác nhau
tip: Khác với thường dùng different from, phù hợp với văn viết trang trọng.

senses.en: An artificial swimming basin or a small area of still water
A supply of money, people, or resources available for shared use
To combine resources so people can use them together

ex.en: We spent the afternoon swimming in the outdoor pool.
Small businesses can pool their resources to purchase equipment that would otherwise be too expensive.

col: a pool of talent｜nguồn nhân tài
tip: pool resources là gộp chung nguồn lực; play pool là chơi bi-a kiểu Mỹ.

senses.en: Earlier than a particular time or event.
Earlier than the time when something happens.
At an earlier time.

ex.en: Please put your shoes by the door before dinner.
Before introducing new transport policies, local authorities should consult residents about their daily travel needs.

col: before long｜ngay sau đó (ngay trước đó)
before making a decision｜trước khi quyết định
tip: Trong mệnh đề thời gian chỉ tương lai, sau before thường dùng thì hiện tại đơn.

senses.en: Extremely good or enjoyable.

ex.en: We had a wonderful picnic beside the lake.
Public libraries offer wonderful opportunities for children to discover new interests without placing financial pressure on families.

col: a wonderful experience｜trải nghiệm tuyệt vời
a wonderful opportunity｜cơ hội tuyệt vời
tip: Nghĩa là tuyệt vời hoặc dễ chịu, không có nghĩa là kỳ lạ.

senses.en: A book of blank pages for writing notes.
A small portable computer with a folding screen.

ex.en: She keeps a small notebook beside her bed.
Keeping a notebook during fieldwork allows researchers to record observations that photographs alone may not capture.

col: write in a notebook｜viết vào sổ tay
a notebook computer｜máy tính xách tay
tip: Thường chỉ sổ giấy; nghĩa máy tính cũng có thể nói notebook computer.

senses.en: having the colour of fresh snow or milk
the colour of fresh snow or milk
the clear part of an egg that turns white when cooked

ex.en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.

tip: egg white là lòng trắng trứng; lòng đỏ là yolk.

senses.en: greater than usual in size, amount, or number

ex.en: A large dog was sleeping beside the kitchen door.
Large cities often offer better employment opportunities, although high housing costs can reduce residents' quality of life.

col: a large number of｜số lượng lớn
a large amount of｜số lượng lớn
large-scale development｜phát triển quy mô lớn
tip: large number đi với danh từ đếm được, large amount đi với danh từ không đếm được.

senses.en: a period of sixty minutes

senses.zh: giờ làm việc; giờ mở cửa
senses.en: the times when someone works or a service operates

ex.en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
Reducing working hours may improve employee wellbeing without necessarily lowering overall productivity in the workplace.

tip: h không đọc, nên nói an hour chứ không phải a hour.

senses.en: Having a husband or wife.

senses.zh: thuộc hôn nhân; đời sống vợ chồng
senses.en: Relating to marriage or life as a couple.

ex.en: My sister is married and lives near the coast.
Affordable housing can help newly married couples establish independent households without placing excessive pressure on their finances.

col: married life｜cuộc sống sau hôn nhân
tip: Kết hôn với ai dùng be/get married to, không dùng with.

senses.en: Containing as much as possible, with no space left.
Including everything, with nothing missing.
Having eaten enough and not wanting more food.

ex.en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
Governments should publish the full results of environmental studies so that citizens can make informed decisions.

tip: full of nghĩa là đầy; chú ý full và fool phát âm khác nhau.

senses.en: the continent west of Asia and north of Africa

ex.en: My cousin travelled across Europe by train last summer.
Many cities in Europe are expanding cycling networks to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.

tip: Europe viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không dùng the; không đồng nghĩa với Liên minh châu Âu.

senses.en: to take place, often without being planned
to do or be something by chance

ex.en: What happened to the plant beside your window?
Traffic accidents are more likely to happen when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.

col: happen to someone｜xảy ra với ai
happen to do something｜tình cờ làm việc gì
happen by chance｜xảy ra tình cờ
tip: Không dùng ở thể bị động; happen to do là tình cờ làm gì.

senses.en: a value used for counting, measuring, or identifying something
the total amount of people or things
to assign identifying figures or add up to a total

ex.en: I saved your phone number on my new phone.
The number of people working from home has increased as digital communication tools have improved.

col: a large number of｜số lượng lớn
tip: a number of đi với động từ số nhiều; the number of đi với động từ số ít.

senses.en: To pick up, hold, or carry something away.
To require a particular amount of time or effort.
To use a particular form of transport.

ex.en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.

tip: Quá khứ took, quá khứ phân từ taken; take là mang đi, bring là mang đến.

senses.en: get pleasure from an activity or experience
have something good, such as a right or advantage

ex.en: We enjoy walking beside the river after dinner.
Residents enjoy better health when their neighbourhoods provide safe walking routes and accessible green spaces.

col: enjoy doing something｜thích làm việc gì
enjoy good health｜có sức khỏe tốt
enjoy the benefits｜được hưởng lợi ích
tip: Theo sau là động từ thì dùng dạng -ing, không dùng to do.

senses.en: the first month of the year

ex.en: Our swimming lessons begin in January this year.
Many people set health goals in January, but maintaining new habits requires consistent support.

tip: Tên tháng viết hoa chữ cái đầu; nói vào tháng Một dùng in January.

senses.en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time

ex.en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.

col: take up a hobby｜bắt đầu một sở thích
a creative hobby｜sở thích sáng tạo
pursue a hobby｜theo đuổi sở thích
tip: Danh từ đếm được, số nhiều là hobbies; bắt đầu một sở thích dùng take up.

senses.en: a person who creates paintings, sculptures, or other art

senses.zh: nghệ sĩ biểu diễn; ca sĩ
senses.en: a person who performs music or other entertainment professionally

ex.en: The artist painted the harbour in soft blue colours.
Public funding allows an artist to create work that enriches community life without depending entirely on sales.

tip: artist là nghệ sĩ; artistic là tính từ “thuộc nghệ thuật”.

senses.en: To be upright on your feet, or get into this position.
To accept something unpleasant without becoming too upset.

senses.zh: lập trường; thái độ kiên quyết
senses.en: A firm opinion or action supporting or opposing something.

ex.en: Please stand near the door until the bus stops.
Local residents took a stand against the proposed road because it would destroy valuable woodland.

col: can't stand doing something｜không chịu nổi việc làm gì
take a stand｜thể hiện lập trường kiên định
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là stood; chịu đựng thường dùng can't stand.

senses.en: used to express a strong obligation or requirement
used to express a confident conclusion
something considered essential

ex.en: You must wear a helmet when riding here.
Governments must ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of their family income.

col: must have done｜hẳn là đã làm
an absolute must｜thứ tuyệt đối cần thiết
tip: must là động từ khuyết thiếu; mustn't chỉ sự cấm đoán, không phải “không cần”.

senses.en: The space above the earth where clouds and stars appear.

ex.en: The sky turned orange as we walked home.
Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars clearly in the night sky.

tip: Thường dùng the sky; skies hay dùng khi mô tả thời tiết hoặc bầu trời ở một nơi.

senses.en: concerning a particular subject
approximately, rather than exactly
in various places within or around somewhere

ex.en: We talked about our holiday plans over dinner.
Schools should teach children about the environmental consequences of their everyday choices and habits.

tip: about có thể chỉ chủ đề hoặc số lượng xấp xỉ; be about to nghĩa là sắp sửa.

senses.en: Two slices of bread with a filling between them.
To place or squeeze something between two other things.

ex.en: I packed a cheese sandwich and an apple for lunch.
School cafeterias can promote healthier eating by offering sandwiches made with wholegrain bread and fresh vegetables.

tip: Khi là động từ thường dùng cấu trúc bị động be sandwiched between.

senses.en: Moving, happening, or taking place at a low speed.
To move or happen less quickly, or make something do so.
Showing a time earlier than the correct time.

ex.en: We took a slow walk along the river.
Slow progress in expanding public transport may discourage commuters from giving up their private cars.

col: slow economic growth｜tăng trưởng kinh tế chậm
tip: slow chủ yếu là tính từ; bổ nghĩa cho hành động thông thường thì dùng slowly.

senses.en: to create or produce something
to cause a state or force an action
the brand or type of a manufactured product

ex.en: We made a small table from leftover pieces of wood.
Schools can make science more accessible by allowing students to conduct simple experiments with everyday materials.

col: make a decision｜đưa ra quyết định
tip: Chủ động là make sb do; bị động là be made to do.

senses.en: referring to all members of a group individually
used to show how regularly something happens
used to emphasize all possibilities or a strong degree

ex.en: Every child brought a favourite toy to the picnic.
Governments should ensure that every student has access to reliable internet services for learning.

col: every reason to believe｜có đủ lý do để tin
tip: every thường đi với danh từ đếm được số ít, động từ cũng chia số ít.

senses.en: making little or no noise
having little activity or excitement

senses.zh: sự yên tĩnh; sự tĩnh lặng
senses.en: a state with little or no noise

ex.en: The house was quiet after the children fell asleep.
Quiet study spaces in public libraries are essential for students who cannot concentrate at home.

col: a quiet neighbourhood｜khu phố yên tĩnh
peace and quiet｜sự yên bình và tĩnh lặng
tip: quiet là “yên tĩnh”, quite là “khá”, chú ý chính tả.

senses.en: to put something with something else or increase an amount
to combine numbers to find their total
to say something more after an earlier statement

ex.en: Add a little milk if the soup is too thick.
Adding more green spaces to urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and provide habitats for wildlife.

col: add something to｜thêm vào cái gì
tip: add A to B là thêm A vào B; add to còn có nghĩa là làm tăng thêm.

senses.en: Something known or proved to be true.

ex.en: We checked the facts before booking our train tickets.
Students should learn to distinguish facts from opinions when evaluating information shared through digital media.

col: establish the facts｜tìm hiểu sự thật
facts and figures｜sự kiện và số liệu
tip: the fact that được theo sau bởi mệnh đề đầy đủ, nêu nội dung của sự thật.

senses.en: pleasant or enjoyable
kind and friendly towards other people

ex.en: We had a nice picnic beside the lake.
Although nice surroundings matter, affordable housing and reliable transport are more important to many urban residents.

col: a nice time｜khoảng thời gian vui vẻ
be nice to someone｜đối xử tử tế với ai
tip: nice có nghĩa khá rộng; trong văn viết trang trọng nên thay bằng tính từ cụ thể hơn.

senses.en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds.
To produce flowers.

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.

col: a bunch of flowers｜một bó hoa
tip: flower vừa là danh từ “hoa”, vừa là động từ “nở hoa”.

senses.en: having many clouds in the sky
not clear or transparent

ex.en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
Solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, although their output is usually lower.

tip: Vừa có thể miêu tả bầu trời nhiều mây, vừa miêu tả chất lỏng bị đục.

senses.en: Having great value or a significant effect.

senses.zh: có ảnh hưởng; có địa vị
senses.en: Having considerable power, influence, or status.

ex.en: Keep your important documents in this waterproof folder.
Access to reliable information plays an important role in helping citizens make informed decisions about their health.

col: an important role｜vai trò quan trọng
an important factor｜yếu tố quan trọng
important to someone｜quan trọng đối với ai
tip: Dùng It is important to do; importance là dạng danh từ.

senses.en: A building where a person or family lives.
To provide a place for people or things to stay.

ex.en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.

col: house families｜cung cấp chỗ ở cho các gia đình
tip: Danh từ đọc /haʊs/, động từ đọc /haʊz/; home nhấn mạnh cảm giác thuộc về gia đình.

senses.en: a polite word for an adult woman

ex.en: A kind lady helped me find the station.
An elderly lady at the meeting explained how the new bus route had improved her daily life.

col: an elderly lady｜một quý bà lớn tuổi
a young lady｜một cô gái trẻ
ladies and gentlemen｜thưa quý ông quý bà
tip: woman là từ trung tính thông dụng; lady thường dùng để xưng hô lịch sự.

senses.en: A large musical instrument played by pressing black and white keys.

ex.en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.

tip: Chơi piano thường nói play the piano.

senses.en: a place where people buy and sell goods

senses.zh: nhu cầu thị trường; lĩnh vực giao dịch
senses.en: the demand for something or the business of trading particular goods
to promote and offer a product for sale

ex.en: We bought fresh peaches at the market this morning.
Companies increasingly market environmentally friendly products to consumers who want to reduce their impact on the planet.

tip: a market for sth chỉ nhu cầu thị trường đối với thứ gì đó.
